Estimated breakdown of what was served:
- 2 fried eggs: 180 kcal, 12 g protein, 1 g carbs, 14 g fat
- 2 slices wholemeal toast: 200 kcal, 8 g protein, 34 g carbs, 3 g fat
- Avocado, about 1/4 to 1/3 of a fruit (~50 g): 80 kcal, 1 g protein, 4 g carbs, 7 g fat
- 2 butter portions (~10 g each): 140 kcal, 0 g protein, 0 g carbs, 16 g fat
- Brownes yoghurt (~150 g): 150 kcal, 7 g protein, 22 g carbs, 4 g fat
- Latte (~300 ml): 150 kcal, 8 g protein, 12 g carbs, 8 g fat
- Savoury muffin (~100 g): 330 kcal, 8 g protein, 35 g carbs, 17 g fat

Served total: about 1230 kcal, 44 g protein, 108 g carbs, 69 g fat.

Leftovers are minimal: crumbs and smears on the plate, a little coffee in the mug, and some yoghurt residue. That comes to roughly 30 kcal.

So the person ate about 1200 kcal, made up of roughly 43 g protein, 105 g carbs and 67 g fat.
